_comment: Copy this to your config folder as campaign.json and edit it. Settings live here as data so changing a campaign never means changing code.

ad_set.name: Leads | US | Instant form
ad_set._destination_type: ON_AD sends people to an instant form. Use LEAD_FORM only if Meta tells you to.

targeting._placements: Manual, Reels and Stories only. Feed crops a 9:16 video and buries the caption.

creative._video: Path relative to this config folder. 1080x1920 works everywhere Reels and Stories run.
creative._texts: Several of each. Meta picks the combination per person rather than splitting your budget across near-identical ads, which matters at a small daily budget.
primary_texts: A second angle on the same offer.

lead_form.name: Lead form v1
lead_form._immutable: Forms cannot be edited once published. Changing this and running `form` creates a NEW form and points the ad at it.
lead_form._context_card: The greeting screen before the questions. Optional, but it is where you restate the offer. LIST_STYLE bullets must each be under 80 characters or Meta rejects the form.
lead_form._questions: Fewer fields get more completions. Add only what you will actually use.
lead_form._custom_disclaimer: Your marketing consent box. Needed before you email or text these leads. Two rules Meta enforces: checkboxes take {key, text}, NOT {required, label}, and the box must default to UNCHECKED. A pre-checked box is rejected.

body.text: Your Business will email and text you about this offer. You can opt out at any time.

checkboxes.text: Yes, send me emails and texts about this. I can opt out anytime.

lead_form._thank_you: The screen after they submit, and where you send them next.

live._comment: Filled in from what `publish --go` prints. `copy`, `form` and `pulse` read these.

monitor._comment: Thresholds for `pulse`. See context/ad-management-principles.md for where each number comes from and how much to trust it.

benchmarks._source: Replace with medians for YOUR vertical. The defaults below are US lead-objective figures and are a starting point, not a target.

thresholds._note: The spend-with-no-lead numbers are house rules, not research. Set them to what you are willing to lose while you find out.
